title: default_budget key in balance.json is dead data — loader never reads it
evidence:
data/balance.json:26:  "default_budget": 5200,

(grep for `default_budget` across all *.odin returns zero hits; the Balance struct in core/catalog.odin has no budget field — its replacement fields are:)
	starting_links:               [dynamic]i32, // per pipe-tier index
	starting_routers:             [dynamic]i32, // per node-type index (routers)
	grants:                       [dynamic]Grant, // hardware deliveries, tick-ordered
detail: The budget→inventory rename replaced the budget with starting_inventory + grants, but left default_budget:5200 in balance.json. The loader never reads it (no Balance field); it's dead data a tuner would change expecting an effect.
recommended_fix: Delete the `default_budget` line from data/balance.json; the live hardware config is starting_inventory + grants.

title: draw_and_upgrade.dem comment says demolish refunds into 'the budget' (now the inventory tray)
evidence:
demos/draw_and_upgrade.dem:3: # over-span upgrade rejection (Perkins r1), demolish refunds into the budget.

core/topology.odin:268: // Moves inventory items directly (consume on build, return on demolish) —
(the Cmd_Demolish case does inv.links/routers += 1, i.e. the hardware tray, not a budget)
detail: Demolish returns links/routers to the inventory tray (topology.odin apply_command), not a budget. The demo header comment misleads readers about where the refund lands.
recommended_fix: Reword demos/draw_and_upgrade.dem:3 to 'demolish refunds into the hardware tray'.

title: hud.odin header comment lists 'budget' among rendered HUD elements (now the hardware tray)
evidence:
app/render/hud.odin:5: // SLA chips, budget, forecast ("weather report"), alerts, and the win/lose

app/render/hud.odin:25: // --- the hardware tray ------------------------------------------------------
detail: The HUD header still lists 'budget' as a rendered element, but the body renders 'the hardware tray' (the inventory). Stale terminology left by the budget→inventory rename; internally inconsistent within the same file.
recommended_fix: Replace 'budget' with 'hardware tray' in the hud.odin:5 header comment (the tray comment is at hud.odin:25).
